run_eval_hand_tracking: run hand pose tracking evaluation on MP4 video files and save tracked keypoints as numpy arrays
find_input_output_files: find input MP4 files and corresponding output paths in a directory tree for batch processing
track_sequence_calibrate_scale: track a video sequence and calibrate hand model scale from predicted samples
track_sequence_full: track a video sequence with a calibrated hand model and save ground truth and tracked keypoints
evaluate_tracking_accuracy: evaluate hand tracking accuracy by computing per-frame mean error between ground truth and tracked keypoints
